submitted.rationale: Of the three EQE measurements, index 8 (Cu 0.58) was highest at 1.3e-3 %. That is about 3x higher than the CuSb2O6-stoichiometry region (idx 15) and the Cu:Sb ≈ 1:1 region (idx 11). EQE appears to rise toward the Cu-rich side (the Cu2SbO5/CuO mixture region).

rejected.reason: Near CuSb2O6 stoichiometry; measured EQE 4.1e-4 %, lower than idx 8
Cu:Sb about 1:1; measured EQE 3.9e-4 %, lower than idx 8
Sb oxides have wide band gaps and likely absorb little at 2.7 eV; not measured
